```yaml name: Skill Check - Token Usage Dashboard on: push: branches: [ main ] pull_request: branches: [ main ] schedule: - cron: '0 2 * * *' # Daily at 2 AM UTC jobs: collect-token-data: runs-on: windows-latest steps: - name: Checkout Repository uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Setup .NET uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4 with: dotnet-version: '6.0.x' - name: Setup MSBuild uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v2 - name: Install Dependencies run: | dotnet restore dotnet build --configuration Release - name: Run Metrics Collection run: | # Run skill validator to collect token metrics dotnet run --project src/SkillValidator/SkillValidator.csproj --collect-metrics - name: Generate Token Data run: | # Run PowerShell script to aggregate token metrics powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/generate-token-data.ps1 - name: Generate Benchmark Data with Tokens run: | # Extend benchmark data generation with token fields powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/generate-benchmark-data.ps1 - name: Upload Token Data Artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: token-usage-data path: data/token-usage.json retention-days: 30 generate-dashboard: needs: collect-token-data runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Checkout Repository uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Download Token Data uses: actions/download-artifact@v4 with: name: token-usage-data path: data/ - name: Setup Node.js uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: '18' cache: 'npm' - name: Install Chart.js run: npm install chart.js - name: Generate Dashboard HTML run: | # Generate dashboard HTML with embedded JavaScript cat > dashboard.html << 'EOF' Skill Check - Token Usage Dashboard

Token Usage Dashboard

EOF - name: Process Token Data run: | # Process token data for visualization node scripts/process-token-data.js - name: Deploy Dashboard uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4 with: github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} publish_dir: . publish_branch: gh-pages commit_message: "Update token usage dashboard" benchmark: needs: collect-token-data uses: ./workflows/benchmark.yml with: name: Skill Check Benchmarks tool: 'custom' output-file-path: data/benchmark-results.json benchmark-data-dir-path: data/ ref: ${{ github.sha }} auto-push: true save-data-file: true comment-always: true summary-always: true test-summary: needs: [collect-token-data, benchmark] runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Checkout Repository uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Display Test Results Summary uses: test-summary/action@v2 with: paths: "test-results/**/*.xml" output: summary.md show: all folded: true ```
